decisions.reason: The requested demonstration video does not change the BOM, component selections, or compatibility requirements.
The source changes the demonstration format and content, not the system-layout or CAD deliverables.
Requesting a video of machine operation does not alter the completed wiring-plan or documentation-retention requirements.
The source conditionally asks that pouring or dispensing be shown in the video; it does not change the dispensing mechanism, sequence, controls, or flow requirements.
The request to demonstrate mechanical performance does not modify the existing structural-stability or vibration-control behavior.
Message 236 does not establish or change any leak-prevention or sealing criterion; it only specifies demonstration content.
Showing matcha being mixed at variable speeds is an acceptance-demonstration requirement and does not change the existing mixing or frothing performance criteria.
The source neither resumes nor changes the deferred accent-lighting requirement; its reference to outstanding components is nonspecific and future-oriented.
The conditional request to show pouring or dispensing does not alter spout geometry, orientation, material, or pour direction.
The demonstration request does not change dispensing-path removability, cleanability, sanitation access, or liquid-trap prevention.
Prioritizing operational demonstration does not resume or modify the deferred decorative-control styling requirement.
The source does not resume or modify the deferred bowl measurement-ring markings.
